column1: # Files every repository carries, whatever stacks it holds.
# Columns: path, policy, then optionally a location (ROOT unless stated) and OVERRIDES <capability>.
# PINNED: the file holds exactly the shipped bytes. SEED: written when absent, then owned by the project.
# SECTION: the file leads with one marked block per capability that claims it; the rest is the project's.
# REFERENCE: optional, and when present it only points at AGENTS.md. FORBIDDEN: the file must not exist.
# Project documentation belongs to the consuming project. The software project guideline is the one
# exception because it defines the agent contract. The Maven startup files and the Java version are
# generic because every repository builds with Maven on exactly Java 25. The JVM options file is pinned with
# them: a -D option there becomes a system property every Maven expression reads ahead of the project's own,
# so a committed one could set skipTests or airness.enforce for every build of the repository.
